target.validation_method: root SSH target probe; no computer-use visual inspection

tests.control_and_input_idle: pass: epoch 0xd1a61001, fpga_state=ready, producer=consumer=0 for two seconds
tests.pcm_queue: pass after a fresh RBF load: 480 stereo S16 records published and consumed by FPGA
tests.two_frame_ownership: pass after a fresh RBF load: two frames claimed by FPGA and the retired slot reclaimed
tests.malformed_magic: pass after a fresh RBF load: expected fault code=1 detail=0x48414958
tests.stale_slot: pass after a fresh RBF load: expected fault code=16 detail=0x00000000

probe_epoch_note: The legacy probe uses a fixed epoch. Each independent test was preceded by an RBF reload so the FPGA observed a new session; reinitializing the same epoch without a reload is intentionally not treated as a reset.
scope_limit: Physical keyboard/mouse/controller edge injection, ARM snapshot recovery on a live overflow, physical left/right audio inspection, Diablo engine launch, HDMI image inspection, tear-free gameplay and frame pacing remain open.
